description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA). This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a dedicated team focused on patient recovery and well-being in a supportive environment.As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting patients in regaining independence in daily living activities. Your responsibilities will include implementing individualized treatment plans, monitoring patient progress, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams to ensure comprehensive care.This full-time position offers competitive compensation, with an hourly rate ranging from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience and qualifications.
requirements: Current Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) certification
Active Florida state licensure as a COTA
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred

description:
Join a premier skilled nursing facility in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, as a Certified Dietary Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to lead our dietary services in a 55-59 bed facility, currently serving a census of 43 residents. We are seeking a dedicated professional to ensure the highest standards of nutritional care and dining experience for our residents. This role offers a competitive salary of $60,000 - $70,000 per year for 8-hour shifts.

Our facility is ideally situated on a main street with abundant shopping nearby, nestled in a nice neighborhood. Enjoy the convenience of being just 15 minutes from the beach, perfect for unwinding after work. The facility also boasts two charming courtyards, providing pleasant outdoor spaces for residents and staff. We are committed to fostering a supportive and engaging environment for both our team and the individuals we serve.
requirements: Proven experience in dietary management within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal dietary regulations
Ability to manage kitchen staff and oversee food preparation
